name: TidyStack
description: A calm way to manage too many tabs. Nothing is ever deleted without your say -- archive, search, and restore, all on your device.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
